_comment: Panel positions in px from the top-left of the usable area (below the bar) on `monitor`. Edit and run `bromigos-widgets reload`. visible=false starts a panel hidden (toggle it with its keybind).

panels.name: network
panels._ping: Hosts for the latency radar. host omitted = the default gateway. NAS from homelab helm/homepage values (nas.url), INGRESS = Traefik's LAN address (homelab CLAUDE.md).

panels.name: workbench
panels._workbench: Recent git repos + zoxide's most-visited folders; projects/folders = how many rows of each.
